Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, Eleanor Cooper, and Christopher [Wolfe] 2. Short news stories 3. Discussion of condom distribution and the public airing of condom ads on network television, getting the gay community "condom comfortable" COMMERCIAL: Jose Sarria for SF AIDS Foundation 4. Mandatory testing for HIV for those working in the public sector COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 5. Andy Humm demonstrates proper condom use 6. News Watch, Chicago Resource Center awards National Coalition of Black Lesbians and Gays $10,000 to support their magazine, "Black Out" 7. California Fair Employment and Housing Commission unanimously rules persons with AIDS protected against discrimination on the job 8. New Hepatitis B vaccine not derived from human blood products now in mass production and widely available 9. BBC cancels plans to air a two part educational drama on homosexuality due to heated public debate on sex education in schools 10. Sports Report 11. The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History, with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: Zamir Furs 2. Media Watch with Brandon Judell, announcement of Robert Latourneau's death, clips from "Boys in the Band" 3. The late Arthur Bell's interview of Robert Latourneau from the "Emerald City Tapes" COMMERCIAL: Night of a Thousand Gowns charity drag ball 4. Show Bits, George Trahanis reviews the off-Broadway production, "The Musical Comedy Murders of 1940" COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation COMMERCIAL: Judge Steven Lachs for the NGTF Fund for Human Dignity 5. Closing credits
